summary: Completed hypothesis-driven probe of OWASP Juice Shop at http://127.0.0.1:3010. Identified 11 confirmed vulnerabilities across auth/session, injection, access control, XSS, and exposure/misconfig categories. Key findings: SQL injection in login endpoint grants admin access; JWT with alg:none accepted without verification; password change endpoint does not require current password; mass assignment via registration allows admin account creation; password hashes leaked via /rest/memories; IDOR on baskets; stored XSS via product reviews; directory listings and sensitive file exposure. Dead ends: SSRF, SSTI, Open Redirect, CSRF bypass, file upload bypass, command injection, .git exposure.

facts: SQL Injection in /rest/user/login: ' OR 1=1-- as email logs in as admin@juice-sh.op, returns admin JWT
JWT with alg:none accepted: server does not verify signature when algorithm is 'none'
Password change at /rest/user/change-password does not require current password if 'current' param omitted
POST /api/Users accepts role=admin during registration, creating admin accounts
POST /api/Users accepts deluxeToken parameter for premium access

/rest/memories leaks MD5 password hashes: 9283f1b2e9669749081963be0462e466 (bjoern@owasp.org), 6edd9d726cbdc873c539e41ae8757b8c (bjoern.kimminich@gmail.com), 0192023a7bbd73250516f069df18b500 (admin@juice-sh.op), 00479e957b6b42c459ee5746478e4d45 (john@juice-sh.op), 402f1c4a75e316afec5a6ea63147f739 (emma@juice-sh.op)
JWT payload contains password hash in plaintext: admin hash = 0192023a7bbd73250516f069df18b500
PUT /rest/products/1/reviews stores XSS payload <script>alert(1)</script> without sanitization
IDOR: normal user can access admin basket via /rest/basket/1 with any valid JWT
IDOR: any authenticated user can list all users via /api/Users
Directory listing enabled at /ftp/, /encryptionkeys/, /support/logs/
JWT RSA public key exposed at /encryptionkeys/jwt.pub
Premium key exposed: 1337133713371337.EA99A61D92D2955B1E9285B55BF2AD42
/rest/user/security-question?email=admin@juice-sh.op reveals security question: Mother's maiden name? (id=2)

Audit config at /support/logs/audit.json shows MD5 hash type and file hashes
CAPTCHA bypass not confirmed: captchaId SQL injection returns 'Wrong answer'
Product search SQLi confirmed: single quote causes SQLITE_ERROR, UNION causes syntax error
Feedback sanitizes HTML: tags stripped from comment before storage
Basket item limit enforced: 'You can order only up to 5 items of this product'
/rest/continue-code returns: 1r2ba7wRJxDY8VB5PABZhQtvcaSJtjc77hQMtKyI3jAqlkpzgj9n6eZ4EymM

Open redirect not exploitable: /redirect returns 406 for unrecognized targets

SSTI not found: {{7*7}} not evaluated in any tested endpoint
deadends: ssrf: No internal request endpoints identified; profile image URL update not testable via REST API
ssti: Login and search endpoints don't evaluate template expressions ({{7*7}}, ${7*7}, #{7*7})
open_redirect: /redirect validates target URL and returns 406 Not Acceptable for unrecognized targets
csrf: Password change without auth header blocked (IP banned); rate limiting/anti-automation in place
file_upload: /profile/image/file rejects non-image files with 'Illegal file type'; SVG files also blocked
git_exposure: /.git/HEAD returns SPA HTML (Angular catch-all), not actual git data
env_exposure: /.env returns SPA HTML, not environment configuration
command_injection: No command injection vectors identified in tested endpoints
nosql_injection_login: Login endpoint rejects object-type parameters with TypeError
captcha_bypass: SQL injection on captchaId parameter returns 'Wrong answer to CAPTCHA'
